summary: Copa Holdings, S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, attaching a press release announcing preliminary monthly traffic statistics for August 2026. Capacity (ASMs) rose 16.8% to 3,219.1 million and revenue passenger miles (RPMs) rose 16.8% to 2,840.9 million versus August 2025, leaving system load factor unchanged at 88.3%. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory element is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer operational update, not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
